name: Campofrio Food Group America
old_description: Somos una compañía multinacional líder en la industria de alimentos que produce, comercializa y distribuye carnes frías, carnes maduradas, lácteos y otros productos en México, Europa, EE. UU. y América Latina.
about:
Campofrio Food Group America operates from South Chesterfield, Virginia, as the U.S. arm of Sigma Foods, a multinational food company owned by the Mexican conglomerate ALFA. While the exact founding date of the American subsidiary is not disclosed, the Campofrio brand originated in Spain in 1952 and became part of Sigma Foods in 2013. The business produces, markets, and distributes a wide range of refrigerated and cured meats, dairy items, and other food products across Mexico, Europe, the United States, and Latin America.

The company leverages Sigma Foods' global footprint of 66 plants in 17 countries, employing more than 48,000 people, to manufacture and distribute approximately 1.8 million tons of food annually. Its portfolio encompasses over 100 brands worldwide, with 16 brands each generating more than US$100 million in net sales. Core operations include meat processing, curing, dairy production, and large-scale distribution supported by a resilient supply chain.

Campofrio Food Group America serves the food manufacturing and consumer packaged goods sectors, supplying retail, foodservice, and industrial channels. Its U.S. presence was strengthened in April 2026 with the acquisition of Roger Wood, a move that expanded its brand portfolio in the American market. Customers range from global retailers to local distributors seeking branded and private-label meat and dairy products.

Differentiation centers on consumer-driven innovation. Sigma Foods operates "The Studio," a global excellence center for design and innovation, and runs "Tastech by Sigma," an open-innovation program that has evaluated more than 2,850 startups and executed 59 pilots across nine countries with a network of over 200 global partners. These capabilities enable rapid development of new products aligned with evolving consumer preferences.
